primary_scope: 前10名候選逐檔評估 × 一般股票基準成本 × 納入報酬 × 進出場有效 × 實際淨報酬非空
group_unit: 持有期間H × 訊號日期 × 市場
notes: Only 前10名候選逐檔評估 has included realized-return observations; the other two trade modes have zero included realized-return rows in this source file.
Pressure-cost rows are not pooled with base-cost rows; this date-market refinement uses the general-stock baseline cost once to avoid duplicate cost scenarios.
Stock-specific factors and v2.51 scores are tested within each signal date and market, then summarized across date-market cells.
Market-context factors are analyzed at the date-market aggregate level only when each factor has a single value within that cell.
Daily cross-sectional rho and top/bottom spreads are descriptive robustness diagnostics; they are not causal estimates and date-market cells can still be serially dependent.
This stage does not retrain the model or use H=3/H=10 as exact v4.70.1 labels.
